name: ColorSwatch

examples.title: Sizes and Shapes
See-Through Colors

accessibility:
- **An image with a name:** it's `role="img"`, named by `label`, by `aria-label`, or by the color
  as written, such as "#1e6b99", so the color is never shown by color alone (WCAG 1.1.1 and
  1.4.1). A role passed in never wins.
- **Hidden where the value is written beside it:** `aria-hidden` keeps it out of the
  accessibility tree, and a development build stays quiet about a `var()` then.
- **What's drawn on it** (its children, such as an icon) is hidden from assistive tech.
- **An edge:** a faint ring in the text color keeps a white swatch visible on a white page and a
  black one on a dark page. Check WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 yourself where the swatch is the only sign of
  something.
- **Forced colors:** it keeps its color (`forced-color-adjust: none`), since the color is the
  point, and takes an edge in the system's text color so it still stands apart from the page.
summary: The `ColorSwatch` component shows a color as a small chip, named by its label or by the color itself. It's an image to assistive tech, so the color is always there in words. In forced colors it keeps its color, edged in the system's text color.

parts.summary: The `ColorSwatch` component shows a color as a small chip, named by its label or by the color itself. It's an image to assistive tech, so the color is always there in words. In forced colors it keeps its color, edged in the system's text color.

props.name: color
props.description: The color it shows: any CSS color, such as `#1e6b99`, `hsl(202, 67%, 36%)` or `var(--bulma-primary)`. A see-through color shows a checkerboard behind it.

props.name: label
props.description: What the color is called, such as "Brand blue", read as the swatch's name in place of `color` as written. A `var()` reads as nothing useful, so a development build warns when one has no name.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Draws a circle in place of a rounded square.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawn on the swatch, such as an icon. It's hidden from assistive tech, since the swatch is an image named by its label.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color helper, the color of anything drawn on the swatch.

extraProps.name: aria-label
extraProps.description: Names the swatch in place of `label`.

extraProps.name: aria-hidden
extraProps.description: Hides the swatch from assistive tech, for one beside text that already names the color.

parts.catchAll: All standard <span> attributes and Bulma helper props
